title: automation moves up out of platform; Platform interface out of platform/gl; launchers into their backends; ring-tool routes grouped
description:
Repo plan phase 1.4 (pure moves). platform/automation imports scenes, gui, canvas and geometry (about 130 imports): it is an application layer. Move it to ixdar/automation, with AutomationRuntime at the automation root (from endpoints/). Group the ring-tool routes (endpoints/mesh/rings/*, mesh/Regions, Connection, Pick, Project) under endpoints/ring, keeping their URL paths. platform/gl/Platform covers windows, files, JSON, the worker pool and the solver backends, not only GL: move it beside platform/Platforms. canvas/IxdarWindow (the GLFW desktop entry) to platform/gl/lwjgl and canvas/WebLauncher to platform/gl/web, keeping class names. graphics/render/Clock and common/utils/Compat to platform. platform/Toggle (knot-editor flags, imports scenes.main.PaneTypes) to scenes/main or tools/knot.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.

AMENDED 2026-10-17: canvas/IxdarWindow and canvas/WebLauncher STAY in canvas, not platform/gl/*. ixdar.canvas.IxdarWindow is named by the pom's exec entries, every .vscode/launch.json entry and ixd's launch-add, and stacked unlanded branches must keep launching against master's tooling.

NOTE 2026-10-18: the automation-runtime injection into LwjglPlatform/HeadlessPlatform made here is superseded by ENG-29 (top of the stack), at the user's ruling that the platform owns the runtime and IxdarWindow knows nothing about automation.
definition-of-done:
1. platform/** imports nothing from scenes, gui, tools, models or automation.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. Every ixdar-cli route still works against a running scene (health, ui-state, screenshot, a ring route).
4. Launch entry and screenshot.

Amendment to item 1 (coordinator, 2026-10-17; moves only): item 1 holds for automation, which platform no longer imports. The remaining platform imports of scenes, gui and tools are left for their owners and are not refactored here: platform/input KeyGuy (gui Terminal, scenes.main Toggle), MouseTrap (MainScene, PaneTypes, HyperString, Toggle), OrbitMouseTrap (HyperString), OrbitCameraKeyGuy (tools ControlHint, Toggle) go to ENG-27 (input merge, phase 2.5); platform/file FileManagement -> scenes.main.Toggle goes to ENG-21 (.ix format to geometry/tsp). Moving Toggle to scenes/main adds those Toggle edges temporarily.
testing-plan:
1. grep imports of platform/**.
2. mvn test; route JSON diff.
3. Live: ixdar-cli health, screenshot, rings-list on the ring scene; the web build if available.
changes-made: Moves: platform/automation -> ixdar.automation (AutomationRuntime at its root); ring-tool routes (mesh/rings Add, Bisect, ListRings + mesh Regions, Connection, Pick, Project) -> automation/endpoints/ring, URL paths and command names unchanged; platform/gl/Platform -> platform/Platform; AutomationBackend -> platform/AutomationBackend (platform's service contract); graphics/render/Clock and common/utils/Compat -> platform; platform/Toggle -> scenes/main; MainSceneKeyGuy -> scenes/main, TradeKeyGuy/TradeMouseTrap -> scenes/trade. canvas/IxdarWindow and WebLauncher stay (amendment). No class renamed. LwjglPlatform/HeadlessPlatform take the AutomationBackend in their constructors (IxdarWindow passes AutomationRuntime.get(); SuitePlatform passes null), so no platform class names automation. MouseTrap.startX/startY/timeLastScroll and KeyGuy/MouseTrap.recordAbstractAction made public for the moved subclasses. pom exec mainClass updated. Verified: compile+checkstyle clean; mvn test 521 run, 0 failures; automation_routes.json identical except sourceClass/sourcePath/generatedFrom; all 6 generated registries list the same ids as the base; TeaVM build OK with no AutomationRuntime in classes.js; live ring-tool scene: health, ui-state, screenshot, pick, project, regions, rings add OK; wt done passed.
